ground_handling.decision_relevance: High when disruption is airport-wide, cargo-linked, or causes cancellations/delays.

refuelling.decision_relevance: High when strike or fuel disruption threatens airport operations or airline capacity.

cargo_handling.decision_relevance: Very high because direct cargo disruption is strongly relevant.

customs.decision_relevance: High when cargo or international shipment clearance is delayed or suspended.

airport_security.decision_relevance: Depends on whether it affects airport-wide security, cargo screening, or operational throughput.

atc_radar_navigation.decision_relevance: Very high when operations are suspended or capacity is materially reduced.

runway_operations.decision_relevance: High when closure/restriction causes meaningful operational impact.

airport_it_cyber_systems.decision_relevance: High when airport-wide operations, cargo processing, or airline dispatch are affected.
